title: Nine Winters and One Short Frame
subtitle: 艺术殿堂 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 艺术殿堂（人与社会·文学、艺术与体育）
meta: 主题语境：艺术殿堂（人与社会·文学、艺术与体育）　|　核心词汇：exhibition　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 exhibition 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1936 my aunt ① held an exhibition that no painter in the city would have entered, and she said the holding was the whole of the winter. The ② exhibition, meaning the show itself and not the museum, ran nine winters and stayed unentered in the book; an exhibition, she said, is the only thing in a city that is judged by how long it is left unentered.

Every ③ exhibition in that city had the same short frame beside it, and the ④ exhibition at the far side, meaning the one they kept for the students and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. An exhibition, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to enter; my aunt said the entering is the part that fills nine winters.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the exhibition was the whole of the season, meaning the display and not the show. The ⑥ exhibition, meaning the display and not any of that, is the only thing in a season that everybody waits for and nobody enters; exhibition, he said, is either something you hold or the only word that means both a show and a display. He said the display is the part they remember.

By 1943 the ⑦ exhibition had become a line in a catalogue, and the catalogue had become an argument about the short frame. The ⑧ exhibition of the whole thing, my aunt wrote in January, was one city and nine winters of entering; exhibition, she said, is either the one at the far side or the reason you learned to enter. She said the entering was never mentioned.

The ⑨ exhibition I remember is the one entered in the catalogue, which closed in 1947 and is still described as the quietest in the city. An ⑩ exhibition, my mother said in 1949, is the only one that improves by being entered; every exhibition, she said, is a display that has agreed to look like a show. She said the display was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 展览；展览会（指城里每一次旁边的那一次）
B. n. 展览（指那一场本身，与美术馆相对）
C. 固定搭配：hold an exhibition 举办一场展览
D. n. 展览（指留给学生们的那一场）
E. n. 展览（抽象总称，指一座城市的展览之事）
F. n. 展览（指目录上写到、被排定的那一场）
G. n. 展出；陈列（指一个展季里人人都等却无人参展的那样东西）
H. n. 陈列（抽象总称，指人人都等却无人参展那样东西）

items.q: held an exhibition that no painter in the city would have entered
The exhibition, meaning the show itself and not the museum
the exhibition at the far side
the exhibition was the whole of the season
the exhibition had become a line in a catalogue
The exhibition of the whole thing

answers.why: hold an exhibition 意为“举办一场展览”，1936 年姑姑举办了一场城里没有一位画家肯参展的展览。
exhibition 意为“展览”，指那一场本身而不是美术馆，它经过了九个冬天而在簿子上没有记号。
exhibition 意为“展览”，指城里每一次旁边的那一次，每一次旁边都有同一只短短的画框。
exhibition 意为“展览”，指留给学生们的那一场，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
exhibition 意为“展出、陈列”，指一个展季里人人都等却无人参展的那样东西，叔叔说这次展出就是那个展季的全部。
exhibition 意为“陈列”，指人人都等却无人参展那样东西而不是那一场展览，是展季里人人都等、却无人参展的东西。
exhibition 意为“展览”，指目录上写到、被排定的那一场，到 1943 年这一场成了目录里的一行。
exhibition 意为“展览”，姑姑一月写道，整件事的展览之事是一座城市和九个冬天的参展。
exhibition 意为“展览”，我记得的是目录上排定的那一场，1947 年结束了，至今仍被说成城里最安静的一场。
exhibition 为抽象总称，母亲 1949 年说，一场展览是唯一会因为被好好参展而变得更好的东西。
